research.title: Image Preparation and Baselines for Surface Defect Classification
bullets: Prepared surface inspection images by checking defect labels, removing duplicate captures, and organizing training and evaluation splits by source component.
Implemented a prescribed baseline using image intensity histograms and support vector classification, reviewing confusion matrices for visually similar defect categories.

work.title: Inventory and Order Processing Support
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing slips, recorded discrepancies, and routed damaged or missing items to the appropriate staff for follow-up.
Organized order paperwork, updated stock logs after routine counts, and prepared pending requests for handoff between shifts.

projects.title: Color Histogram Baseline for Scene Classification
bullets: Implemented a scene classification baseline using normalized color histograms and a nearest neighbor classifier under a fixed training and test split.
Compared histogram binning choices on validation images and inspected classification errors involving similar color distributions across distinct scene categories.
